rows.observed: A separately copied display-only x1_commit value had a mistyped suffix while all four Git-derived refs were correct and equal.
rows.recovery: Derive the label from the resolved Git head and rerun the bounded proof.

rows.observed: The first x2 current-phase run passed 15 x1 tests and failed the exact-cardinality Method Flow assertion because M05 was correctly appended.
rows.recovery: Assert the frozen M01-M04 methods and witnesses as required subsets while allowing later append-only records.

rows.observed: The runtime checks completed but locale-default console encoding rejected a non-ASCII boundary character before runner credit.
rows.recovery: Escape non-ASCII code points in machine JSON stdout while preserving UTF-8 artifacts.

rows.observed: The uncommitted generated receipt captured a raw error tail containing private local paths and was rejected before evidence commit.
rows.recovery: Replace raw streams with byte counts, digests, and bounded categories, then rerun privacy validation.

rows.observed: A wildcard pattern interpreted question marks as wildcards and falsely counted all 214 staged paths as untracked.
rows.recovery: Use a literal two-character prefix test and count staged, unstaged, and untracked paths separately.

rows.observed: The full 217-path review payload exceeded the app display budget and was truncated, while the written receipt and compact verification remained complete.
rows.recovery: Keep complete arrays in the receipt and print only bounded count summaries.

rows.observed: The wrapper exceeded its 120-second envelope after the index update completed and left two owner-started Git processes without an index lock.
rows.recovery: Inspect exact lock and stage state, avoid duplicate retry, and terminate only the identified owner-started orphan processes.
rows.surface: combined evidence restage and enumeration wrapper

rows.observed: The index update passed but repeated line-ending warnings exceeded the app display budget and truncated the displayed output.
rows.recovery: Suppress repetitive warning output, stage only changed paths, and rely on compact exact-state and manifest checks.
rows.surface: targeted evidence index refresh warning stream

rows.observed: A per-command normalization override staged CRLF generated text, and cached diff hygiene rejected both index files with an overlarge truncated diagnostic.
rows.recovery: Re-add only the two generated files through normal repository normalization and rerun diff hygiene.

rows.observed: Later Git probes overwrote the earlier nonzero cached-diff status, so the wrapper returned success despite a visible failure.
rows.recovery: Capture each native exit code immediately and fail on the stored value.
